title: [spec-gap][R-X509-048/050/015] RFC 5280 chain validation to trust anchor + leaf basicConstraints/keyUsage + no issuer-DN matching
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md section 8 steps 1-3 and section 3: chain MUST validate per RFC 5280 to a configured trust anchor; basicConstraints CA=false and keyUsage digitalSignature MUST be checked on each end-entity cert; verifiers MUST NOT match on issuer DN for authorization (chain validation to the anchor is the only issuer-based decision). Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: only X.509 code is python/src/lichen/crypto/trust_anchors.py:77-111 (pubkey_from_der_cert) which does key-pinning only and explicitly defers chain validation (docstring cites stale bead viku.6, which no longer exists); TrustLevel::Pkix is a label only in rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs:47, rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs:111, lichen/subsys/lichen/gcp/include/lichen/gcp_trust.h:79. No path building, signature checks, or validity processing anywhere. Suggested placement: python cryptography.x509-based chain verifier; rust gateway validator; C minimal DER chain walker (mbedTLS X.509 if enabled).
close_reason: Parent verified complete: children .12.1/.12.2/.12.3 are closed and implement Python, Rust, and C RFC 5280 validation. Rust lichen-gateway/link focused test command passed gateway and exposed one unrelated pre-existing lichen-link shared-vector failure (sos_alert_dispatch kind). Python focused run was blocked by missing optional dependencies (lora_medium, textual). Kimi correctness/security/edge delegated reviews were attempted but failed due insufficient OpenRouter credits; fallback self-review found no additional defects.
